limitations: Signing lines have no own timestamp; their payload and exact rolling-tail overlap are preserved with capture boundaries and separately observed committed serials.
Four signing samples describe this run; their nearest-rank p99 is simply the maximum, not a stable tail estimate.
Azure metrics are one-minute platform container usage, not process RSS or attested measurements. The API returned timestamps truncated to seconds; minute buckets may include adjacent time.
The ACI secondary metric is the auxiliary UDP-only BIND; the independently queried TCP/UDP secondary is the separate VM and has a separate process-RSS report.
Raw container stdout remains private; only fixed-schema signing diagnostics, hashes and overlap counts are public.
These measurements exercise the exact uninstrumented image above; the subsequent requested OTel implementation is a separate candidate.
